sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland for the 2026--2027 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Relates to limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland for 2026-2027.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown in Rockland county to alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purposes of installing a cellular tower
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown in Rockland county to lease certain lands used as parklands to Homeland Towers, LLC for the purposes of installing a cellular tower.

sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland for an additional year for 2026-2027.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax; repealer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited in the community preservation fund; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Simcray Holdings, LLC. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Simcray Holdings, LLC. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the village of Nyack to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Nyack to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to use the funds received for the acquisition of new parklands and/or capital improvements to existing park and recreational facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to banned members of social referral services
sponsored.sum: Relates to bans from online dating services based on content; requires retention of records where necessary to maintain enforcement of fraud bans or content bans; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice to fire departments when oxygen is in use at a residence
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to develop a conspicuous warning sticker for the purpose of notifying firefighters that a residence contains a flammable oxygen delivery system.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain villages in Rockland county to enter into binding arbitration
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain villages in Rockland county to enter into binding arbitration.

sponsored.t: Relates to the qualifications to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Allows a non-resident to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland.

sponsored.t: Relates to the lemon law applied to new or used motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to the lemon law applied to the purchase or lease of new or used motor vehicles; updates and amends provisions of the lemon law relating to mileage, fines and arbitration procedures, and notices to consumers.

sponsored.t: Provides that transportation shall be provided to all children attending grades kindergarten through twelve who live within a fifteen mile radius of the school they legally attend
sponsored.sum: Provides that transportation shall be provided to all children attending grades kindergarten through twelve who live within a fifteen mile radius of the school they legally attend; provides that such transportation may also be provided for such students to before-and/or-after-school child care locations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes George Orfanoudakis to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes George Orfanoudakis to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Daniel Woolley to receive an accidental disability retirement
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Daniel Woolley to file for an accidental disability retirement.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Karen Siegel
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Karen Siegel.

sponsored.t: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code
sponsored.sum: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code by counties.

sponsored.t: Enacts the ride N.Y. act ordering a New York integrated travel project
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York State Department of Transportation to conduct an integrated travel project in tandem with the Office of General Services, Department of Motor Vehicles, regional transportation authorities and county-run public transit providers to address state-wide transportation needs.

sponsored.t: Relates to missing or non-functioning airbags in vehicles for sale
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Anthony Amoros law"; requires an automobile auctioneer, retail dealer or individual seller to disclose missing or non-functioning airbags in vehicles for sale.

sponsored.t: Relates to absentee ballot drop boxes
sponsored.sum: Requires a board of elections to establish at least one ballot drop-off location in its jurisdiction; requires the ballot drop boxes to be placed 45 days before the election.

sponsored.t: Relation to the state's liability for damages caused by defects on state roads
sponsored.sum: Imposes liability on the state for injuries or damage sustained by persons while traveling on state highways, if the same are caused by a defect or dangerous condition that the state had notice of, but did not repair.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of housing and community renewal shall conduct a study on the demographics of tenants living in rent-stabilized apartments in Nassau, Rockland, and Westchester Counties; repealer
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of housing and community renewal shall conduct a study on the demographics of tenants living in rent-stabilized apartments in Nassau, Rockland, and Westchester Counties, and in the City of Kingston; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to requisite training for police officers for crimes involving human trafficking; and relates to requisite training for entities providing public transportation
sponsored.sum: Requires state and municipal police academy course training in the recognition and handling of matters involving human trafficking; requires public transportation authorities and contractors to provide training in the recognition and handling of matters involving human trafficking.

sponsored.t: Adjusts the regional labor force cost index for the Hudson Valley region
sponsored.sum: Adjusts the regional labor force cost index for the Hudson Valley region for the 2025--2026 school year and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections to a chapter of the laws of 2025 relating to authorizing the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections to a chapter of the laws of 2025 relating to authorizing the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes.

sponsored.t: Exempts political subdivisions from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts political subdivisions from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

sponsored.t: Creates a congestion toll offset tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates a congestion toll offset tax credit.

sponsored.t: Allows the thruway authority to offer a discounted toll rate to residents of Rockland and Westchester counties for Mario M. Cuomo bridge crossings
sponsored.sum: Allows the thruway authority to offer discounted tokens to residents of Rockland and Westchester counties for Mario M. Cuomo bridge crossings.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to establish the Lake DeForest Flood Control Pilot Program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to establish the Lake Deforest Flood Control Pilot Program.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing bed and breakfasts to sell cider, liquor, beer and wine
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing bed and breakfasts to sell cider, liquor, beer and wine on the licensed premises.

sponsored.t: Establishes a no fare program for certain police officers on the the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company and the New York City Transit Authority
sponsored.sum: Requires the Long Island Rail Road, the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company, and the New York City Transit Authority establish a no fare program for the transportation of certain active duty, uniform police officers.

sponsored.t: Grants a total exemption from real property taxation for school tax purposes for certain persons seventy-five years of age or over
sponsored.sum: Grants a total exemption from real property school tax for property owned by a person seventy-five years of age or older, or owned by spouses or siblings if one such person is seventy-five years of age or over, provided the owner has no children in the school district and has resided in the district for 30 years or more.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state public health care option program; and establishes the New York state public health care option program fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state public health care option program to provide a comprehensive and affordable health care insurance option for all residents of this state; establishes the New York state public health care option program fund.

sponsored.t: Allows boards of cooperative educational services to install school bus stop sign cameras
sponsored.sum: Allows boards of cooperative educational services to install school bus stop sign cameras.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax exemption for real property owned by a person in active military service of the United States and their spouse
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax exemption for real property owned by a person in active military service of the United States and their spouse to the extent of fifteen percent of the assessed value of such property.

sponsored.t: Expands remedies for violations of New York state uniform fire prevention and building code
sponsored.sum: Expands remedies for violations of New York state uniform fire prevention and building code.

sponsored.t: Exempts attorneys from the definition of theatrical employment agency
sponsored.sum: Exempts attorneys from the definition of theatrical employment agency.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Raymond Ruckel
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Raymond Ruckel.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability retirement benefits for Dennis Malone, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, and cleanup operations
sponsored.sum: Entitles Dennis Malone, an employee of the Town of Clarkstown who retired from such service on August 16, 2018, and who participated in the World Trade Center rescue, recovery and cleanup operations to a 75% accidental disability retirement benefit.

sponsored.t: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts and increases filing fees
sponsored.sum: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts; increases filing fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payroll tax of the metropolitan commuter transportation district
sponsored.sum: Excludes the counties of Orange and Rockland from the payroll tax of the metropolitan commuter transportation district.

sponsored.t: Defines film zone and excludes the film zone from the additional empire state film production credit
sponsored.sum: Defines film zone; excludes the film zone from the additional empire state film production credit.

sponsored.t: Directs public service commission to require electric and steam corporations to provide rate reductions or refunds for inadequate or interrupted service
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to require electric and steam corporations to provide rate reductions or refunds for inadequate or interrupted service; requires electric corporations to reimburse ratepayers for damages to and losses of property and business caused by power outages in certain instances.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of homeland security and emergency services to establish rules and regulations providing for truck rental security
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of homeland security and emergency services to develop rules and regulations relating to truck rental security; requires any person or organization in the business of renting trucks, vans or trailers to the public to be registered with the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes a penalty and cause of action for intentional destruction of medical records by a party to a medical malpractice action, or by an agent thereof
sponsored.sum: Establishes a penalty of not less than $1,000 for each intentional destruction, mutilation or significant alteration of a medical record by a party to a medical malpractice action, or by any officer, director, member, employee or agent of such party; establishes a cause of action on behalf of any person injured as the result of such destruction, mutilation or significant alteration; requires disclosure of metadata, audit trail, and log-in information associated with electronic medical records in certain actions.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts and other facilities providing universal prekindergarten programs utilize all allotted funds for universal prekindergarten programs
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts and other facilities providing universal prekindergarten programs utilize all allotted funds for universal prekindergarten programs.

sponsored.t: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent
sponsored.sum: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal impersonation in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Includes impersonation of a firefighter in the definition of criminal impersonation in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring principals to notify co-trustees and co-beneficiaries of the signing of a power of attorney
sponsored.sum: Requires principals to make a good faith effort to identify and notify co-trustees and co-beneficiaries of the signing of a power of attorney including the identity of the agent where the agent is not a co-trustee or co-beneficiary.

sponsored.t: Relates to minimum staffing levels for agencies enforcing the minimum standards under the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the content of rules and regulations to be promulgated by the Secretary of State with respect to minimum staffing levels for agencies enforcing the minimum standards under the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code Act.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Judy A. Lynch, the widow of James G. Lynch, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Judy A. Lynch, the widow of James G. Lynch, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of her deceased husband with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Phases out the sale of products that contain intentionally added PFAS
sponsored.sum: Phases out the sale of products that contain intentionally added PFAS.

sponsored.t: Directs the public service commission to provide a class of service for facilities that use large amounts of energy; and repeals certain provisions upon the expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to provide a class of service for facilities that use large amounts of energy; requires an electric company that is providing electricity service to a retail electricity consumer that is a large energy use facility to enter into a contract with the retail electricity consumer that covers the provision of the electricity service; repeals certain provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Creates an electric school bus infrastructure investment pilot program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates an electric school bus infrastructure investment pilot program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of paid sick leave for bereavement purposes
sponsored.sum: Allows an employee to use paid sick leave for bereavement upon the death of a family member, or upon pregnancy loss by the employee or the employee's spouse or domestic partner or upon a foster child leaving a foster family provided the foster child was in the care of the foster family for six months or longer.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for paid sick leave
sponsored.sum: Requires an employer to provide sick leave to an employee who telecommutes at the same rate and under the same conditions that an employee present at the employer's work site would accrue it.

sponsored.t: Relates to termination of utility service to a commercial tenant
sponsored.sum: Allows a commercial tenant with a triple net lease to hold back rent if the landlord fails to pay the utility bill.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 39 Chapter 658 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 6657, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to authorizing the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes" APPROVED This bill would authorize the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes. This bill as originally drafted requires a technical fix due to the unique legal status of the Thiells-Roseville Fire District, which oper- ates within a special district. As such, it is covered under a different section of the Real Property Tax Law ("RPTL") than was initially refer- enced in the bill. The provisions governing special districts differ from those applicable in the municipal fire districts. The technical correction is necessary for the Thiells-Roseville Fire District to prop-…

sponsored.t: Relates to the time-limit for appeals in all categories of family court cases
sponsored.sum: Relates to the time limit for appeals in all categories of family court cases and the filing of objections to support magistrate determinations in child support, paternity and parentage proceedings in family court.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland to Hector L. Soto
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland to Hector L. Soto.

sponsored.t: Limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Relates to limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland for 2025-2026.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of chapter 329 of the laws of 2009, relating to removing special powers granted to the society for the prevention of cruelty to children
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing special powers granted to the society for the prevention of cruelty to children.

sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland for an additional year.

sponsored.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland for the 2025--2026 assessment rolls.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provision of law relating to value limitations for certain emergency contracts for public works or the purchase of supplies
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions of law relating to value limitations for certain emergency contracts for public works or the purchase of supplies.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties having a population of more than three hundred thirty-eight thousand and less than three hundred forty thousand, determined in accordance with the latest federal decennial census.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Rockland to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to John F. Leonard, Jr., a deputy sheriff employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Rockland to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to John F. Leonard, Jr., a deputy sheriff employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Makes a technical change to the tax law; extends the village of Nyack occupancy tax
sponsored.sum: Makes a technical change to the tax law; extends the authorization of the village of Nyack to impose an occupancy tax.
